The following Act of Parliament
received the assent of the President on the 17th January 1975, and is hereby
published for general information:-
THE SCHEDULE
(See section 3)
(i) Exemption from the provisions
of the West Pakistan Arms Ordinance, 1965 (W. P. Ordinance No. XX of 1965) or
any other law for the time being in force relating to the possession of arms,
firearms or ammunition.
(ii) Diplomatic passport.
(iii) Access to Government Guest
Houses, Rest Houses and Circuit Houses in the country free of charge.
(iv) Installation of telephone at
residence at Government expense and exemption from payment of its rental and of
charges of calls made therefrom to the extent of two thousand and four hundred
rupees, during a financial year in the aggregate.

The following Act of Parliament

1. Short title and

(2) It shall come into force at

Amount and condition of pension

ACT IX OF 1975
ACT IX OF 1975
PRESIDENT'S
PENSION ACT, 1974
An Act to make provision for the payment of pension to
persons who have held the office of President
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 20th January 1975]
The following Act of Parliament
received the assent of the President on the 17th January 1975, and is hereby
published for general information:-
2. Amount and condition of
pension.---There shall be payable to every person who, having held, after
the nineteenth day of December 1971, the office of President for not less than
two years and not having been removed there from for violating the Constitution
or gross misconduct, has ceased to hold such office, a monthly pension for life
of two thousand rupees:
Provided that the right to
receive pension under this Act shall be suspended for the period that a person
entitled to receive it holds any office in respect of which he draws salary or
other remuneration from the public exchequer:
Provided further that the
condition of holding office for not less than two years shall not apply in the
case of a person who has held the office of President under the Interim
Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan.
(2) A person entitled to receive
pension under subsection (1) may, within one month from the date on which he
becomes so entitled, elect to receive gratuity in lieu of pension and, if he so
elects, shall be paid as gratuity a sum free from all taxes, calculated at the
rate of twenty-five thousand rupees for every one year proportionately for each
completed calendar month of his office subject to a maximum of two lakhs of
rupees.
(3) If a person referred to in
subsection (1) dies without receiving any pension under that subsection or
electing for gratuity under subsection (2), he shall be deemed to have elected
for gratuity and the sum due to him as gratuity shall be paid to the person
nominated by him in this behalf or, in the absence of such nomination, to his
heirs.
